verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ κατ’ ἐπαγγελίαν ζωῆς τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Paulos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos Theou kat’ epangelian zōēs tēs en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Paul an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus, por vontade de Deus, segundo a promessa da vida que é em Cristo Jesus,

verses.original: Τιμοθέῳ ἀγαπητῷ τέκνῳ Χάρις ἔλεος εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Timotheō agapētō teknō Charis eleos eirēnē apo Theou Patros kai Christou Iēsou tou Kyriou hēmōn
verses.literal: To Timothy my beloved child Grace mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord
verses.literalPt: ao muito amado filho Timóteo: graça, misericórdia e paz da parte de Deus Pai e da de Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor.

verses.original: Χάριν ἔχω τῷ Θεῷ ᾧ λατρεύω ἀπὸ προγόνων ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει ὡς ἀδιάλειπτον ἔχω τὴν περὶ σοῦ μνείαν ἐν ταῖς δεήσεσίν μου νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: Charin echō tō Theō hō latreuō apo progonōn en kathara syneidēsei hōs adialeipton echō tēn peri sou mneian en tais deēsesin mou nyktos kai hēmeras
verses.literal: I thank God whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers
verses.literalPt: Dou graças a Deus, a quem, desde os meus antepassados sirvo, com consciência pura, de que sem cessar, faço menção de ti em minhas súplicas, de noite e de dia,

verses.original: ἐπιποθῶν σε ἰδεῖν μεμνημένος σου τῶν δακρύων ἵνα χαρᾶς πληρωθῶ
verses.transliteration: epipothōn se idein memnēmenos sou tōn dakryōn hina charas plērōthō
verses.literal: Recalling your tears I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy
verses.literalPt: desejando ver-te, recordando-me das tuas lágrimas, para que o meu gozo seja completo;

verses.original: ὑπόμνησιν λαβὼν τῆς ἐν σοὶ ἀνυποκρίτου πίστεως ἥτις ἐνῴκησεν πρῶτον ἐν τῇ μάμμῃ σου Λωΐδι καὶ τῇ μητρί σου Εὐνίκῃ πέπεισμαι δὲ ὅτι καὶ ἐν σοί
verses.transliteration: hypomnēsin labōn tēs en soi anypokritou pisteōs hētis enōkēsen prōton en tē mammē sou Lōidi kai tē mētri sou Eunikē pepeismai de hoti kai en soi
verses.literal: I am reminded of your sincere faith which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and I am convinced is in you as well
verses.literalPt: lembrando-me daquela fé não fingida que há em ti, a qual habitou primeiro em tua avó Loide e em tua mãe Eunice, e estou persuadido de que também, em ti.

verses.original: Δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν ἀναμιμνῄσκω σε ἀναζωπυρεῖν τὸ χάρισμα τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅ ἐστιν ἐν σοὶ διὰ τῆς ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν μου
verses.transliteration: Di’ hēn aitian anamimnēskō se anazōpyrein to charisma tou Theou ho estin en soi dia tēs epitheseōs tōn cheirōn mou
verses.literal: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands
verses.literalPt: Por essa razão, te lembro que tornes a acender o dom de Deus que há em ti pela imposição das minhas mãos.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ Θεὸς πνεῦμα δειλίας ἀλλὰ δυνάμεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ σωφρονισμοῦ
verses.transliteration: ou gar edōken hēmin ho Theos pneuma deilias alla dynameōs kai agapēs kai sōphronismou
verses.literal: For God has not given us a spirit of fear but of power love and self-control
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus não nos deu o espírito de timidez, mas de força, de amor e de prudência.

verses.original: Μὴ οὖν ἐπαισχυνθῇς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν μηδὲ ἐμὲ τὸν δέσμιον αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ συνκακοπάθησον τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ κατὰ δύναμιν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Mē oun epaischynthēs to martyrion tou Kyriou hēmōn mēde eme ton desmion autou alla synkakopathēson tō euangeliō kata dynamin Theou
verses.literal: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord or of me His prisoner Instead join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God
verses.literalPt: Não te envergonhes do testemunho de nosso Senhor, nem de mim, que sou prisioneiro seu; antes, sofre comigo pelo evangelho segundo o poder de Deus,

verses.original: τοῦ σώσαντος ἡμᾶς καὶ καλέσαντος κλήσει ἁγίᾳ οὐ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἰδίαν πρόθεσιν καὶ χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων
verses.transliteration: tou sōsantos hēmas kai kalesantos klēsei hagia ou kata ta erga hēmōn alla kata idian prothesin kai charin tēn dotheisan hēmin en Christō Iēsou pro chronōn aiōniōn
verses.literal: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling not because of our works but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began
verses.literalPt: que nos salvou e nos chamou com uma santa vocação, não segundo as nossas obras, mas segundo o seu propósito e segundo a graça que nos foi dada em Cristo Jesus, antes dos tempos eternos,

verses.original: φανερωθεῖσαν δὲ νῦν διὰ τῆς ἐπιφανείας τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καταργήσαντος μὲν τὸν θάνατον φωτίσαντος δὲ ζωὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: phanerōtheisan de nyn dia tēs epiphaneias tou Sōtēros hēmōn Christou Iēsou katargēsantos men ton thanaton phōtisantos de zōēn kai aphtharsian dia tou euangeliou
verses.literal: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel
verses.literalPt: e que agora se manifestou pela vinda de nosso Salvador Cristo Jesus, que destruiu a morte e tirou à luz a vida e a imortalidade pelo evangelho,

verses.original: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κήρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος καὶ διδάσκαλος
verses.transliteration: eis ho etethēn egō kēryx kai apostolos kai didaskalos
verses.literal: to which I was appointed as a preacher an apostle and a teacher
verses.literalPt: no qual eu fui constituído pregador, apóstolo e mestre.

verses.original: Δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν καὶ ταῦτα πάσχω ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐπαισχύνομαι οἶδα γὰρ ᾧ πεπίστευκα καὶ πέπεισμαι ὅτι δυνατός ἐστιν τὴν παραθήκην μου φυλάξαι εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν ἡμέραν
verses.transliteration: Di’ hēn aitian kai tauta paschō all’ ouk epaischynomai oida gar hō pepisteuka kai pepeismai hoti dynatos estin tēn parathēkēn mou phylaxai eis ekeinēn tēn hēmeran
verses.literal: For this reason even though I suffer as I do I am not ashamed for I know whom I have believed and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day
verses.literalPt: Por essa razão, sofro também essas coisas; mas não me envergonho, porque sei a quem tenho crido e estou persuadido de que ele pode guardar o meu depósito até aquele dia.

verses.original: Ὑποτύπωσιν ἔχε ὑγιαινόντων λόγων ὧν παρ’ ἐμοῦ ἤκουσας ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hypotypōsin eche hygiainontōn logōn hōn par’ emou ēkousas en pistei kai agapē tē en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Conserva o modelo de sãs palavras que de mim ouviste na fé e no amor que há em Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: τὴν καλὴν παραθήκην φύλαξον διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου τοῦ ἐνοικοῦντος ἐν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: tēn kalēn parathēkēn phylaxon dia Pneumatos Hagiou tou enoikountos en hēmin
verses.literal: Guard the treasure entrusted to you with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us
verses.literalPt: Guarda o bom depósito com o auxílio do Espírito Santo, que habita em nós.

verses.original: Οἶδας τοῦτο ὅτι ἀπεστράφησάν με πάντες οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ ὧν ἐστιν Φύγελος καὶ Ἑρμογένης
verses.transliteration: Oidas touto hoti apestraphēsan me pantes hoi en tē Asia hōn estin Phygelos kai Hermogenēs
verses.literal: You know that everyone in the Province of Asia has deserted me including . . . Phygelus and Hermogenes
verses.literalPt: Tu sabes isto: que me abandonaram todos os que estão na Ásia, do número dos quais é Fígelo e Hermógenes.

verses.original: Δῴη ἔλεος ὁ Κύριος τῷ Ὀνησιφόρου οἴκῳ ὅτι πολλάκις με ἀνέψυξεν καὶ τὴν ἅλυσίν μου οὐκ ἐπαισχύνθη
verses.transliteration: Dōē eleos ho Kyrios tō Onēsiphorou oikō hoti pollakis me anepsyxen kai tēn halysin mou ouk epaischynthē
verses.literal: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus because he has often refreshed . . . me and was unashamed of my chains
verses.literalPt: O Senhor use de misericórdia para com a família de Onesíforo, pois ele, muitas vezes, me consolou e não teve vergonha das minhas cadeias;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ γενόμενος ἐν Ῥώμῃ σπουδαίως ἐζήτησέν με καὶ εὗρεν
verses.transliteration: alla genomenos en Rhōmē spoudaiōs ezētēsen me kai heuren
verses.literal: Indeed when he arrived in Rome he searched diligently until he found me
verses.literalPt: antes, quando veio a Roma, me procurou diligentemente e me achou

verses.original: Δῴη αὐτῷ ὁ Κύριος εὑρεῖν ἔλεος παρὰ Κυρίου ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ὅσα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ διηκόνησεν βέλτιον σὺ γινώσκεις
verses.transliteration: Dōē autō ho Kyrios heurein eleos para Kyriou en ekeinē tē hēmera kai hosa en Ephesō diēkonēsen beltion sy ginōskeis
verses.literal: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus
verses.literalPt: (que o Senhor lhe conceda a graça de achar misericórdia diante do Senhor naquele dia); e quanto serviço prestou em Éfeso, melhor o sabes tu.
